title: The Night Journey
intro: One verse for the Isra and Mi'raj, the Prophet's Night Journey, remembered by many Muslims on 27 Rajab.

posts.display_original: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
posts.caption: Many Muslims remember the Isra and Mi'raj, the night journey of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and his ascent through the heavens, on 27 Rajab, which begins around the evening of January 4 or 5 this year, depending on the moon; some scholars do not mark a date. The verse glorifies Allah for carrying him by night from the Sacred Mosque in Mecca to al-Aqsa, the "Far distant place of worship", in Jerusalem, to show him some of His signs.
